exposure: Thyroperoxidase antibody (TPOAb) positive in the first trimester
Overt hypothyroidism restricted to women negative for TPOAb
Gestational age at time of test (≤18 weeks, >18 weeks)
finding: While there was no overall association between thyroid dysfunction or autoantibody positivity and preterm birth, TPOAb positivity in the first trimester and overt hypothyroidism in women negative for TPOAb were associated with an increased risk of preterm birth.
